budget_items.topic: Electricity reserve and Fitchburg Solar credit
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Director was told to reserve an electricity amount; about $6K may be credited back to the library, with the refund dates and terms unclear.
budget_items.quote: martha stated that john londa informed her to reserve $17k for electricity. of that amount, we can expect somewhere around $6k to be credited back to the library.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The library will still receive Unitil bills for distribution and other electric power-related fees; no figure printed.
budget_items.quote: we will still receive a bill from unitil for

budget_items.topic: Summer food program (Meal 4 Kids / Project Bread)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The summer lunch program costs the library nothing; a possible expansion to four days depends on funding.
budget_items.quote: no cost is incurred by the library for the program.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: About one third of the stuffed chairs will be refurbished each year over three years, paid from Friends money (last year's endowment).
budget_items.quote: roughly 1/3 of all stuffed chair will be refurbished with money from the friends

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Firm bids are being sought over the summer; current bids are seven years old and moving costs must be included in the project cost.
budget_items.quote: martha is seeking firm bids over the summer for commercial carpeting

budget_items.what_was_recorded: All invoices for the LED project have been paid in full although the project is not complete; all green funds for it are spent.
